mutations.name: a line that only gained a trailing comma still counts as a change
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is in scope when the only change past a trailing comma is the approved entry

mutations.name: an approved removal covers an added line of the same text
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the approved entry was a removal of the same text

mutations.name: one approved key covers every key the reviewer named
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when a key the reviewer named is not approved

mutations.name: lines the card cap left out are taken as in scope
kills: a weakened CI-policy line against a plan approval is out of scope when the card cap left a line out or a file read closed

mutations.name: an allow names no plan round
kills: the plan honour of one decision names the round of the approval that covered a row, and nothing when none did
